svg.title: Where the classifier disagreed with the human coders
svg.desc: Confusion matrix for the 250 held-out posts. Most disagreements are human-coded theme posts that the classifier sent to 'fits no theme'.
svg.text: Rows: what the two human coders agreed. Columns: what the classifier said.
Diagonal = agreement (175 of 250). Amber = disagreement; the first column holds 45 of the 75 misses.
